ratelimitGlobal.restartHint: Switches and thresholds take effect immediately after saving. Values in the collapsed section are fixed at startup and require a restart to change.
ratelimitGlobal.loadFailed: Configuration is not ready yet, click Refresh to retry
ratelimitGlobal.apiKeyDesc: Enforced against each API Key's own per-minute limit and acts as the global cap for that key. With a shared counter window across replicas, the cap applies to all replicas combined.
ratelimitGlobal.apiKeyDisabledHint: Disabled: no per-minute judgement for any API Key; hourly, daily and monthly quotas still apply.
ratelimitGlobal.endUserDesc: After L1 passes, requests are additionally limited per end user so that one downstream user cannot consume the whole key's allowance.
ratelimitGlobal.endUserDisabledHint: Disabled: no per-end-user limiting; requests are bounded only by L1 and quotas.
ratelimitGlobal.headerEnabledHint: When allowed, the identity is read from the X-End-User-Id header first; when disabled it is inferred only from the request body user field and metadata.user_id. Identities never appear in clear text in counter keys or logs.
ratelimitGlobal.apiKeyCacheLabel: API Key level local counter capacity
